title: (Pwn2Own) Adobe Acrobat Reader DC Net.HTTP.request URL Restriction Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Adobe Acrobat Reader DC. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.
